content.text: {"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot \"accessory\" is for an item no other slot fits.", "\"is_outfit\" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following \"answer_schema\", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": ["\"description\" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Outfit not suitable for this request as the specified occasion (rock concert at a club) conflicts with the strict dress code requirements and formality levels defined in the system instructions, which prioritize neat, smart, or formal wear over athleisure or loungewear. Additionally, the user's specific refusals regarding lightness numbers and body measurements must be adhered to while constructing an outfit that respects the \"strict and classic\" intent despite the informal venue, requiring a creative compromise within the allowed fashion boundaries that balances personal style with the event's energetic atmosphere. Therefore, no single outfit can be generated without violating the core constraints of the task parameters or the user's explicit wishes for a refined look in such an environment."}
